title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Settlement Lead, Payment Minimums and Deferral Terms
content:
Payment terms on Grain Marketing Contracts are programme terms. The catalogue below carries, for each marketing programme, the business days between the settlement statement and the release of funds, the smallest net settlement for which a payment is cut, whether payment may be deferred into a later year and for how long, and the channel by which contract and settlement statements reach the member.

| Programme | Settlement lead (business days) | Smallest net settlement paid (USD) | Deferral allowed | Longest a deferred payment is held (calendar days) | Statements reach the member by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 1 | 5.00 | No | 0 | a printout handed over at the counter |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 3 | 25.00 | Yes | 120 | a statement in the post |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 3 | 25.00 | Yes | 120 | a statement in the post |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 3 | 25.00 | Yes | 180 | a statement by email |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 5 | 25.00 | Yes | 120 | a statement by email |
| Minimum Price Contract | 5 | 25.00 | Yes | 180 | a statement by email |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 7 | 50.00 | Yes | 180 | the member portal and by email |

The settlement lead is counted in business days from the statement date. The smallest net settlement is the least the cooperative will cut a payment for; a net below it is carried forward rather than paid. The deferral column says whether the programme opens a deferred payment at all, and the days column is the longest such a payment is held from the statement date.

## Illustrative reading

On a hypothetical Managed Accumulator Program statement, funds are released 7 business days after the statement date, a net of 50.00 is paid and a net of 49.00 is not, and a deferral elected on that statement is held no longer than 180 calendar days. On a hypothetical Spot Cash Delivery Ticket, funds are released 1 business day after the statement date, a net of 5.00 is paid, and no deferral is open at all.
